parsed.notes: The 5.00x leverage limit at 9/30/2026 is not stated in the same sentence as the 4.44x actual. It comes from Amendment 1, which raised the maximum from 4.25x to 5.00x for periods ending March 31, 2026 through December 31, 2026. Amendment 2 (Nov 2, 2026, after the period end) sets future maximums: 5.25x at 3/31/2027; 5.00x at 6/30/2027 and 9/30/2027; 4.75x at 12/31/2027 and 3/31/2028; 4.50x at 6/30/2028 and 9/30/2028; 4.25x from 12/31/2028 onward. These future limits are not included as entries because no actuals exist for those dates. The 3.50x Senior Secured Leverage test is a debt-incurrence basket condition, and the leverage-based pricing grid sets interest margins and fees; both are excluded. The covenant disclosure is repeated in the notes and in MD&A with identical figures.
